title: CampusGo / Order service
description: HTTP and logical database performance, messaging and durable event delivery. Current values require fresh application telemetry.

panels.title: Telemetry freshness
panels.description: Instant value at the selected range end. Fresh telemetry is not a readiness probe. HTTP filters apply to completed HTTP metrics; no traffic has no error fraction/latency estimate.

targets.expr: ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name=~"order-service"})) < bool 45) or on(service_name) ((label_replace(vector(0), "service_name", "order-service", "", "")) - 1)

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: Instant value at the selected range end. Fresh telemetry is not a readiness probe. HTTP filters apply to completed HTTP metrics; no traffic has no error fraction/latency estimate.

targets.expr: (sum by (service_name) (rate(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="order-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="order-service"}) < 45))

panels.title: HTTP 5xx · selected range
panels.description: Histogram/request summary over the entire selected dashboard range, rather than only the current rate window. Short idle periods do not discard earlier requests in that range. No requests means no estimate, and fresh application telemetry is still required.

targets.expr: (((sum by (service_name) (increase(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="order-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}",http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range]))) or on(service_name) (0 * (sum by (service_name) (increase(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="order-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}"}[$__range]))))) / on(service_name) ((sum by (service_name) (increase(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="order-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}"}[$__range]))) > 0)) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="order-service"}) < 45))

panels.title: HTTP p95 · selected range
panels.description: Histogram/request summary over the entire selected dashboard range, rather than only the current rate window. Short idle periods do not discard earlier requests in that range. No requests means no estimate, and fresh application telemetry is still required.

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (service_name,le) (increase(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="order-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}"}[$__range])))) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="order-service"}) < 45))

panels.title: Estimated HTTP requests · selected range

targets.expr: (sum by (service_name) (increase(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="order-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}"}[$__range]))) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="order-service"}) < 45))

panels.title: Route & method comparison
panels.description: Rolling summary of requests within the selected dashboard time range, evaluated at its end and recalculated on refresh. Counts, average requests/s, HTTP 5xx fraction, and p50/p95/p99 all use the same range. panels.title: Order snapshot collection p95
panels.description: Independent read-only aggregate timings. Availability can remain 1 after a failed read while the previous successful snapshot is within 90s. Independent order business snapshot; account/outbox observations use their own monitors.

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (service_name,outcome,le) (rate(campusgo_order_snapshot_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="order-service"}[$__rate_interval])))) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="order-service"}) < 45))
